visual_requirements.description: Balarama as Hindu deity with unmistakable immense plough weapon; one head/two arms are restrained editorial rendering, clothing opaque.
The plough draws the Yamuna into a newly torn channel, water physically redirected by the deity rather than routine agriculture.
Yamuna river approaching Vrindavan, torn riverbank and surging water during the documented deed.

artistic_choices: Opaque ivory tunic, indigo drapery and antique gold crown are editorial devotional clothing choices, not sourced anatomy.
Majesty from close foreshortened commanding action and superhuman river-redirection deed, no claimed literal giant body.
